Trade quest in Rookgaard: pick a {item:Banana} from a {item:Bananapalm} and take it to {npc:Willie}, the village farmer, who swaps it for a {item:Studded Shield}.
No Premium needed (the eastern palm tree is in the Free area).
Nothing required; a shield is recommended
Only for the palm tree in the Premium area: 3 {item:Box|boxes}
On the way you may run into {creature:Wolf|Wolves}, {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Spider|Spiders} and {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}: at very low levels, bring a shield.
Go to the {item:Bananapalm} in the **east** of Rookgaard.
Alternative: the palm tree in the Premium area
In the Premium area (northwest) there is also a palm tree. Climb the wolf hill, take the 3 {item:Box|boxes} to the flat part, stack them and jump up to the Bananapalm.
Go to {npc:Willie}, in the village, and say {key:hi}, {key:banana} and {key:yes}. He exchanges the banana for a shield.
